instruction: Please recover the browser tab that was just closed.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to reopen the last closed tab (etsy.com) using Ctrl+Shift+T. Evaluator verifies all 3 shopping websites are present in open tabs.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses get_open_tabs_info getter to retrieve all currently open tabs
Metric is_expected_tabs appropriately checks if all expected URLs (amazon, ebay, etsy) are present
Logic correctly verifies that the closed tab (etsy.com) was recovered by checking if all 3 original tabs are now open
Coverage is complete - evaluator checks the core requirement (tab recovery) by verifying presence of previously closed URL
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Potential issue: are_lists_equal function may be order-sensitive. If Chrome reopens the tab in a different position than original, evaluation might fail. Consider using set-based comparison or explicitly document that tab order must be preserved.

Minor robustness concern: If agent opens additional tabs beyond the 3 expected ones, the current logic may still pass/fail depending on are_lists_equal implementation. Consider clarifying if extra tabs should be allowed.
